name: Ball-playing centre-back
description: More carries, passes, receptions; less own-box share, long-pass share than others in the group.
examples: Jeison Murillo, Lorenzo Tonelli, João Miranda de Souza Filho, Federico Fernández

name: Box-defending stopper
description: More own-box share, long-pass share, opponent-box share; less passes, carries than others in the group.
examples: Enzo Roco, Nicolás Burdisso, Ryan Shawcross, Mikel González

name: Wide centre-back (back three)
description: More distance from centre, average action depth, crosses (open play); less own-box share, clearances (adj.) than others in the group.
examples: Geoff Cameron, Pedro Mendes, Armando Izzo, Marc Muniesa

name: Touchline progressor

name: Possession full-back
